name: Hollywood Studios Thrill Run
intro: Hollywood Studios punches well above its weight for thrill rides — five genuinely great ones in a 135-acre park is a better ratio than any other Disney World park. This is the order to tackle them in, and why.

rides.blurb: The flagship — 18 minutes of the most technically ambitious Disney ride ever built. Do this first, rope drop, no exceptions.
The park's original anchor ride and still the most atmospheric — a genuine dark ride disguised as a drop tower, with Twilight Zone storytelling that actually lands.
The hardest 57 mph in any Disney park: three inversions in the dark with Electric Mayhem on the soundtrack. Brand new Muppets theming as of May 2026.
The 'family coaster' that grown-ups end up enjoying more than expected. Book the Lightning Lane first thing or you'll be waiting 70 minutes by noon.
You're the crew now. Even if you draw engineer duty, the new Grogu interaction (May 2026) makes the consolation feel intentional.
